items.quote: Whereas the First Political Theory (liberalism) took the individual as its subject, the Second (communism) took class, and the Third (fascism) took race or state, Dugin proposes that his "Fourth Political Theory" takes Heidegger's collective *Dasein* ("being-there") and the undifferentiated mass (*Narod*) as the only real actor.
